description: Create or update a WidgetDash data source shown on the user's iPhone Home Screen / Lock Screen widgets and Live Activities. Sets the source's title, SF Symbol icon, category and its full list of metrics (label + value + type + color). The metrics list REPLACES the source's current metrics; use push_number to change a single value. Omitted display_name/icon/category keep their current values; sort_order only applies when the source is created. Requires WIDGETDASH_WRITE_KEY.

category.description: Free-form grouping, e.g. 'finance', 'monitoring', 'fitness'. If omitted, keeps the existing category (default 'general').

display_name.description: Title shown on the widget, e.g. 'Stripe'. If omitted, keeps the existing name (or derives one from source_key for new sources).

icon.description: SF Symbol name shown next to the title, e.g. 'dollarsign.circle.fill', 'chart.bar.fill', 'server.rack', 'heart.fill', 'cart.fill'. If omitted, keeps the existing icon (default 'circle.fill').

metrics.description: Metrics to show, in display order. Small widgets show the first few, so put the most important first.

color.description: Optional accent color. Tip: green = good, yellow = warning, red = bad, gray = neutral.

label.description: Short label shown on the widget, e.g. 'MRR' or 'Users online'.

type.description: How the widget renders the value: 'number' = big bold figure (counts, money, KPIs); 'text' = plain short string; 'status' = colored badge (e.g. 'Healthy', 'Down'); 'progress' = bar, value must be 0-100; 'percentage' = compact percent text; 'timestamp' = a moment shown as live relative time (e.g. '8 hours ago'), value is ISO 8601 like 2026-10-23T05:00:00Z or Unix epoch seconds. If omitted: 'number' for numeric-looking values (42, $12,400, 3.5%), otherwise 'text'.

value.description: The value to display, pre-formatted as you want it shown (e.g. '$12,400', '42', 'Healthy'). For 'progress' use 0-100; for 'timestamp' an ISO 8601 time or Unix epoch seconds.

wide.description: Optional. true gives the metric a full-width row of its own on Large widgets (iOS app 1.8+), for long text such as a title. Other text that shares a row shows up to two lines. Put wide metrics last to keep the others in one row.

raw_data.description: Optional arbitrary JSON object stored alongside the metrics (not shown on the widget). If omitted, existing raw_data is kept.

sort_order.description: Position for a NEW source among your sources (lower first, default 0). Ignored when updating an existing source: its order is set in the WidgetDash app.

source_key.description: Stable identifier for this data source, e.g. 'stripe_mrr' or 'server_health'. Lowercase letters, digits, '_' or '-'. Pushing to an existing key updates it; a new key creates a new widget source.

name: push_metrics
title: Push metrics to iPhone widget
